load_and_preprocess_images_square: load and preprocess images by center padding to square and resizing to target size with coordinate tracking
load_and_preprocess_images_crop: load and preprocess images in crop mode setting width to 518px and center cropping height if needed
load_and_preprocess_images_pad: load and preprocess images in pad mode preserving all pixels by padding smaller dimension to square shape
handle_rgba_alpha_composite: handle RGBA images by blending onto white background before converting to RGB tensor
pad_mismatched_image_shapes: pad images with different shapes using white padding to ensure uniform batch dimensions
